LineComment.Text: Global supervision: E-Stop, gate fault, or a forced-open
event force the sequence back to RTE_REQUESTED from the
two states where automatic operation is assumed.
IF (NOT #NoEStop OR #GateFault OR #ForceRTE)
AND (#CurrentState = #AUTO_RUNNING
OR #CurrentState = #READY_TO_RESTART) THEN
#CurrentState := #RTE_REQUESTED;
END_IF;
Solenoid is now de-energised->energised per GateUnlockPermissive,
which physically frees the mechanism so the operator can rotate
the manual handle. Transition to manual mode once the gate is
actually opened.
Gate physically closed again (handle rotated back, solenoid
still energised/unlocked at this point - lock only re-engages
in RESETTING once Reset is pressed).
Lock is commanded via GateUnlockPermissive=FALSE
(see output mapping below); wait for GS1/GS2 to
confirm locked before allowing restart readiness.
OUTPUT MAPPING
GateUnlockPermissive drives O_S1_SolenoidEnergise (assumed
energise=unlock) in FB_GateAccessControl. In RESETTING /
READY_TO_RESTART / AUTO_RUNNING the gate must be LOCKED,
so permissive is FALSE (commands lock, per assumption).
